events.trigger: It is still unclear whether the person is the customer after the confirm question was asked a second time (only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirm; hello, go ahead or who is this do not).

events.trigger: Every persuasion attempt is used up. A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one attempt: a no to paying today with no date and no amount, refusing the floor, not accepting the floor after a below-floor amount, or refusing the deadline. A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal.

extra_rules.text: If the person asks a question instead of confirming (for example whether you are a robot or whether this is a scam), answer it first; the confirm question asked after that answer is the second ask.
A relative or anyone other than the customer may not answer the security questions and may not be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
After a mention of illness, a death in the family or job loss, if the customer still names a date or an amount themselves, record the promise under the normal date and amount rules.
Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.
If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason, not as promise.
